artifact.notes: Wrap-phase COPQ re-run with post-improvement actuals over a STATED window: the first 4 weeks after the round-2 change was implemented beyond its pilot, 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-16, 19 weekday service mornings. Same four categories, same sources, same rates as the Q2 baseline COPQ (coffee-copq) so the two runs compare money to money: remakes from the barista waste sheet at the invoiced $1.10, comps from the POS comp log reason-code 'wait' at the $4.80 average, walk-aways from the same morning tally method at the $5.25 average ticket (still the one estimate row), overtime from the time-clock export at $16.50. The engine computes every row amount and the total; nothing here is hand-typed. Window total $252.95 against the Q2 baseline pro-rated to an equal 4 weeks ($4,021 x 4/13 = $1,237.23) -- the before/after money the A3's realized-benefits panel runs on, with the pro-rating named there as an assumption (Q2 was summer session; this window is semester, ~15% busier, which if anything understates the recovery). Recorded in control-run.md.

rows.basis: Remade drinks on the barista waste sheet across the window's 19 service mornings (~2.3 per 100 orders at semester volume); per-remake cost from the same supplier invoices as the Q2 run
POS comp log, reason code 'wait', across the window -- down from ~65 per equivalent 4 weeks in Q2; rate is the same average comped-drink price
Estimate, same method as Q2: pickup-counter walk-away tally averaged ~1 per morning across the 19 mornings (Q2 ran 6 per morning); average ticket from the POS
Time-clock export, morning-shift overtime code: 2.0 hours across the window (~0.1 per morning, against Q2's 0.65) -- the peak backlog that drove it no longer builds

assumptions_checked: each row's amount is quantity * rate, never hand-entered
